title: Phone Use In Class
query: Nag-lecture among maestra, okay ra motan-aw og message sa cp?

en: The use of mobile phones during class is strictly prohibited, especially when the instructor is leading a discussion, but use during activities and other curricular activities will depend on the classroom rules set by the instructor.
ceb: Bawal gyud kaayo ang paggamit og cellphone samtang nagklase, labi na kung nag-discuss ang maestro/maestra, pero kung gamiton sa activities ug uban pang curricular activities, magdepende na na sa classroom rules nga gipahimutang sa maestro/maestra.
